notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later. Lists the selected account's available themes; returned items are strings and an empty list is preserved.
Omit showMailThemes to retain the server default 0. Explicit false sends 0 and true sends 1; true includes the account's mail themes. This does not change the active theme.

evidence.note: Pinned /Themes/update declares x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none. Use form POST, retaining any credentials outside query strings.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later. Applies the named theme to the selected account's cPanel interface with no rollback. The supplied theme string is forwarded unchanged.

Status 1 means the theme changed; status 0 means no change or failure and remains an API error. The data schema permits a nullable object: preserve explicit null and opaque object fields, and reject an absent data member.
